description: This file manages Wi-Fi applications, including event handling, registration, initialization, and communication between different Wi-Fi app modules. It contains functions for event dispatching, app lifecycle management, and updating RFC parameters.

classes.name: wifi_app_t
classes.description: Represents a Wi-Fi application instance, including its state, event handling, and lifecycle management.

classes.name: wifi_apps_mgr_t
classes.description: Manages a collection of Wi-Fi applications, including registration, event dispatching, and lifecycle control.

methods.name: get_app_by_inst
methods.description: Retrieves a Wi-Fi app instance by its identifier from the apps manager.

methods.name: app_detached_event_func
methods.description: Thread function for handling detached app events, processing queued events periodically.

methods.name: push_event_to_app_queue
methods.description: Clones and pushes an event into the application's event queue.

methods.name: apps_mgr_event
methods.description: Dispatches an event to the appropriate Wi-Fi applications based on unicast or broadcast logic.

methods.name: apps_mgr_analytics_event
methods.description: Creates and dispatches an analytics event to the analytics app.

methods.name: apps_mgr_sm_event
methods.description: Creates and dispatches a state machine event to the SM app.

methods.name: apps_mgr_cac_event
methods.description: Creates and dispatches a CAC event to the CAC app.

methods.name: apps_mgr_link_quality_event
methods.description: Creates and dispatches a link quality event to the link quality app.

methods.name: app_deinit
methods.description: Deinitializes a Wi-Fi app, cancelling its thread if detached.

methods.name: app_init
methods.description: Initializes a Wi-Fi app, setting up synchronization primitives and starting event thread if detached.

methods.name: update_rfc_params
methods.description: Updates RFC parameters in the app descriptor based on database values.

methods.name: app_register
methods.description: Registers a new Wi-Fi app with the apps manager.

methods.name: apps_mgr_init
methods.description: Initializes the apps manager with a set of app descriptors.
